name: Complete Tau Implies Complete Theta
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every partial cube with complete tau-graph has complete Theta-graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: For every partial cube, $G^\tau$ is a subgraph of $\Theta(G)$. Hypercubes of dimension at least two have complete Theta-graph and edgeless tau-graph.
